nodes.description: legends → build → eval. RuleSet-scoped team building and evaluation. The core user surface.

Community + profile
+ players explorer
nodes.description: Leaderboard of public Saved Teams, user profile, player explorer.

nodes.label:
Admin surfaces
/admin/*
nodes.description: Calibration (threshold editor), pipeline dashboard, snapshot drafts + skill-evaluation runner (Skill scope, run-mode checkboxes, Discard a stuck run), review queue (Skill filter + per-Skill bulk bar) and its phone swipe deck (/admin/review/deck, #166: one Skill-filtered queue request loads every card; answers go through the same resolve endpoint, held 5 s in the browser for undo), legends editor, rulesets, cohesion calibration. Requires user_roles.role = 'admin'.

nodes.label:
apiFetch<T>()
lib/api.ts
nodes.description: Single chokepoint for all backend calls — injects JWT + base URL. Types in lib/types.ts mirror backend shapes. Envelope: { success, data, error }.

nodes.label: Flask app — 17 blueprints
nodes.description: app.py factory. Blueprints: builder, calibration, players, legends, pipeline, review, rulesets, saved_teams, community, evaluation_versions, snapshots… @require_admin guards admin writes (JWT + user_roles). review resolves one Skill across many players in bulk (agreements-only, batched writes, paged flag reads); composite refuses a whole-profile persist over human decisions with 409.

nodes.label:
skill_engine/
stat → skill
nodes.description: Evaluates 23 skills against JSONB threshold rules: conditions, tier bumps, auto-promotions, stabilization, pre-adjustments (deepcopy is load-bearing). Writes skill_profiles (source: stats). evaluation_only.py drives a Skill-scoped snapshot-draft run; a filtered stats run keeps the unfiltered Skills, and its with_claude path stages a MERGED claude-source composite.

nodes.label:
Pipeline orchestration
stats_assembler + nba_api_client
nodes.description: Fetch → assemble player_stats JSONB → evaluate → persist. Plus salary_scraper for salary ingestion.

nodes.label:
claude_assessment
+ compositing
nodes.description: Claude rates a chosen subset of the 23 skills (all 23 by default); compositing merges vs stat ratings — agreements auto-accepted, disagreements become skill_flags for the review queue. Fresh Claude tiers merge through the human-decision guard (#120), so a human entry stays put and gets a flag instead. Staged flags carry claude_justification + stat_values, so the diff preview can show why Claude disagreed.

nodes.label:
cohesion_engine/
team evaluation
nodes.description: Sole evaluation engine: lineup subscores, composites, synergies, accentuation, rotation combos, bell-curve normalization, Claude narrative. Warmed from the active Evaluation Version at startup.

nodes.label:
evaluation_versions/
immutable snapshots
nodes.description: Publishes cohesion weights + composites as immutable versions. One active at a time; Saved Teams pin a version.

nodes.label: Supabase PostgreSQL
nodes.description: player_stats, skill_profiles, skill_flags, legends, rulesets + versions, evaluation_versions, saved_teams, rosters, snapshot tables, user_roles. A draft run stages into the snapshot draft tables; the admin reads the diff, then a commit RPC promotes them. SECURITY DEFINER RPCs locked to service_role (linted).

nodes.label: Dev deploy — develop → hestia
nodes.description: Push to develop → self-hosted GH Actions runner builds both Docker images (frontend + backend) → dev stack at cornerstone-dev.hestia.chrooks.com with its own self-hosted Supabase. Deploy-time only — not part of the runtime request path.

nodes.label: NBA.com Stats
nodes.description: Live season stats, fetched via the nba_api Python client.

nodes.label: Claude API
nodes.description: Skill ratings (second opinion vs stats engine), legend suggestions, team narratives.
